paras: Boie's day gecko (Cnemaspis boiei) is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to India.
C. boiei is named after Friedrich Boie (1789–1870) or his brother Heinrich Boie (1794–1827), German naturalists.
C. boiei may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of almost 4 cm (1.6 in).
